sections.title: Owner: runs and settings only the owner can do

intro: Admin browser sessions, cPanel, SSH, scripts on the owner's computer. Tools that change data show a dry run first; add `?apply=1` to act. The date is when the item was last confirmed open.

items.text: **Share the inspection report folder** (2026-10-17). Share `My Drive/KOP Inspection Reports` as "Anyone with the link", then `php api/sync-inspection-archive.php apply` on the server and check the dry run lists index entries for every state. Until then the nightly sync drops the archive index of every scraper folder (old 3.3 item 6).

**Severe findings scan cron** (2026-09-29). Add the line in `docs/state-inspection-reports/README.md` in cPanel > Cron Jobs; send the first lines of `/home/kidsover/logs/inspection-highlights-scan.log`.

**Monthly Unsilenced check cron** (2026-09-30). Add as is: `0 4 1 * * cd /home/kidsover/public_html/wp-content/themes/child && /opt/cpanel/ea-php82/root/usr/bin/php api/list-unsilenced-files.php restart --check --minutes=120 >> /home/kidsover/logs/unsilenced-check.log 2>&1`. On its mail, ask a session for the rebuild (old 2, item 10).

**News discovery crontab** (2026-10-13). (a) the 13:30 line loses `--no-facilities`; (b) the 01:30 line gets `--recency 30d` for one night, then loses it; (c) optional: drop `AI_PROVIDER=groq` from both; (d) optional: a third line at 07:30 (old 3.8, old 3.16).
**Drive Sync schedule** (2026-10-17). Keep the nightly `15 3 * * *`, or `*/15 * * * *` for documents within 15 minutes.
**PDF covers** (2026-09-29: 177 left). [regenerate-pdf-previews.php?apply=1](https://kidsoverprofits.org/wp-content/themes/child/api/regenerate-pdf-previews.php?apply=1) until it reports 0.

**Staff "Former" passes** (2026-10-17, both with exact undo, dry runs done): on the server `php api/fix-staff-unconfirmed.php apply` (2,651 entries on 226 open programs) and `php api/fix-wiki-staff-former.php apply` (29 wiki entries on 21 records).

**Search Console** (2026-10-15). Grant Site Kit the Search Console permission (Settings > Connected services), or export Performance and "Why pages aren't indexed" to Sheets. Then delete `~/kop-gsc.json` and `~/kop-gsc.err` on the server.

**Small cleanups.** Delete the two tokens made under the old GitHub account (github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens); remove the duplicate `public_html/.env`; delete comment 453 on [/hyde/](https://kidsoverprofits.org/hyde/) (a staging pingback); clear the leftover `wpdl_anonymous_submissions` row or drop the table; optional: ask NixiHost to purge `SUB-2025-YLVUY0CL` from backups.

**State Lists upload** (2026-10-05). Ask a session for `tmp/state-lists/state-lists.json`, upload it to `~/kop-import/state-lists/` (make the folder beside `kop-import/gdocs`), then review at [KOP Tools > State Lists](https://kidsoverprofits.org/wp-admin/admin.php?page=kop-state-lists).

**Featured report notes** (2026-09-18). Add a `featured_note` to the two featured UHS of Provo Canyon reports in [manage-featured-inspections.php](https://kidsoverprofits.org/wp-content/themes/child/api/manage-featured-inspections.php).

groups.title: Scrapers and long runs on the owner's computer

items.text: **PA rerun with OCR version 2**: `python pa_scraper.py --full` (~5,750 documents, ~5.5 s a page, needs 1.5 GB free). Replaces the 164 waiting 2012-17 PA findings (old 3.3 item 5).

**Backfills**: MN with Chrome closed (`py -3 scrapers/mn_scraper.py --backfill-pdfs`, ~20 min); CA is the owner's call (30,885 reports: sync the mirror, then `py -3.14 ca_scraper.py --backfill-pdfs`). Fixed 2026-10-20 in kop-pipeline `c228130`: CCL's end-of-list answer (HTTP 400 "Index out of range") had made every facility count as unfinished, so each run started over. CCL now takes ~1 minute a report page, so the whole walk is closer to 3 weeks than 3-5 days; it resumes, so it can run in evening stretches. GA, TX and CT were started 2026-10-17: confirm they finished.

items.lead: First posts, then publish the page
items.text: **First posts, then publish the page** (run from the launcher): New Hampshire, Wyoming, Idaho, Maine, Ohio, Iowa, Maryland, South Dakota, Virginia (run VDSS again first, and `va_scraper.py --no-post --source dbhds` once from cache), Hawaii, West Virginia (after 2.4's decisions). Colorado: blocked (2026-10-20). The dashboard's View Data command (`get-view-data-dialog-tab-pres-model`) never answers, though every other call answers in under 2 s; it is the only way to the lists and the citation text. See `plans/colorado.md` Status. Next: one View Data try in real Chrome on an evening, or a Colorado Open Records Act request to CDPHE for the inspection and citation data.
**Regular runs**: Oklahoma at least monthly; New Hampshire, Wyoming and Ohio monthly; Hawaii quarterly; WA once with `wa_scraper.py --full` and `KOP_DATA_API_KEY`.

**Unsilenced backup** (once I: has room, ~2.5 days, 118 GB): start `Start-Process python -ArgumentList 'scripts/unsilenced-backup.py','run' -WindowStyle Hidden` in kop-pipeline; keep C: above 4 GB. Then ask a session for the titles and rebuild (old 3.11).
**Document finder retries**: `py tti_doc_finder.py upload --retry-failed` (1,783 failed, 383 waiting).
**Scraper launcher window**: open it and confirm the size and Output pane look right.

**Card add-ons**: on a Nonprofit tax filings card, "Link to a company", pick "New company named ...", check its note and folder, Undo from the Linked tab.

**Admin kit screens**: [Drive Docs](https://kidsoverprofits.org/wp-admin/admin.php?page=kop-drive-docs), [Fornits](https://kidsoverprofits.org/wp-admin/admin.php?page=kop-fornits), [Woodbury Facts](https://kidsoverprofits.org/wp-admin/admin.php?page=kop-woodbury-facts): add one, Undo, cards stack on a phone.

At [Provo Canyon School documents](https://kidsoverprofits.org/facility/provo-canyon-school-ut/#documents): no stray pencils, "Select documents", move a few, Undo; the same on a company page.

**Lighter pages**: [Provo Canyon School](https://kidsoverprofits.org/facility/provo-canyon-school-ut/) in a private window: open "more articles" and the Unsilenced groups, pick a document type, print preview.

**Names then on company pages**: [Three Springs](https://kidsoverprofits.org/operator/three-springs-inc/) lists "Three Springs of Courtland" (now Brighter Path Courtland); Sequel TSI lists "Sequel TSI Courtland".

Hide one, save it in the admin data form, check `operator.directoryHidden` survives. On the directory: fold two alternate names, Undo; Set company on a row, check the listing and the facility page, Undo.

**People**: open KOP Tools > People once (makes the tables); after the hourly sync, a person on two programs shows the same "Also worked at" on both; tick "Became an educational consultant" on one, check the facility page; add a relationship between two map people, check both pages and the next map build draws it.

**Data entry changes of 2026-10-14 and 10-17**: KOP Tools > Document Types shows the 7 staff-ideology documents and the editor's notes, retype waiting AI guesses; paste court-order text at /submit-lawsuit/, KOP Tools > Lawsuits and a pending lawsuit card; "Mark as lawsuit news" then Undo; Review inbox > Conflicts (Kind: Type) "Both are right" then Undo; tick two types on a Facilities from News card.

intro: Pick from here. Items marked "owner first" need the owner's word before starting.

items.text: **News discovery after a week** (from 2026-10-20): approved vs rejected for `auto-discovery via google-news` against the 45 / 109 baseline, `batch-unconfirmed` rows in Scraper finds (any real story?), the cursor and "AI confirmations" lines in `~/logs/discovery-2026-10.log`. Then tune `AI_CONFIRM_PER_RUN`, `GN_SUBMIT_EVERY` and the blacklist. If real stories sit in batch-unconfirmed, add "It is about <name>" to Scraper finds (old 3.16).
**AI budget**: read AI Usage for each provider's real daily ceiling and set `KOP_AI_DAILY_GEMINI` / `_GROQ`.

**Batch confirmation check** (from 2026-10-20, d7577bd3): read the "not about ... (AI: {...})" lines in `~/logs/discovery-2026-10.log` after two nightly runs. Is discoveryCheck there on every hit (a missing one turns the hit down)? Did a real story get turned down for its place (record with the wrong state, or a program the AI named differently)? Not yet run against the real AI: the eval harness needs the server's internal key, and copying it to `~/tmp` was refused in auto mode. Baseline: 27 batched hits Oct 8 to 20, owner approved 8, rejected 19. Checked 2026-10-20 17:10 Central: too early. The 13:30 run still logged the old "not about" line with no "(AI: ...)", so the first run with the new code is Oct 21 01:30 Central (06:30 UTC); two runs = after Oct 21 13:30. Batched submissions are `news_submissions` (WordPress DB) rows with `submission_notes LIKE 'auto-discovery via google-news%' AND submission_notes LIKE '%query=% | % | %'` (the batch query is the names joined by " | "); `created_at` is server time (Central), so new-code rows are `created_at >= '2026-10-21 01:30'`. That filter gives 12 approved / 12 rejected / 4 waiting for Oct 8 to 20 today (the 27/8/19 baseline was counted differently). Watch: confirm_batch_attribution() turns a hit down when the record has a state and neither discoveryCheck.place nor location names it, so an AI that leaves place empty turns real stories down. Checked again 2026-10-20 17:21 Central: still before the first new-code run; next look after Oct 21 13:30 Central (still not run at 12:55 Central Oct 21).

Then compare against the stored `_yoast_wpseo_metadesc` / `_yoast_wpseo_focuskw` in tmp/prod.sqlite. items.lead: Facility pages scroll sideways on desktop
items.text: **Facility pages scroll sideways on desktop** (found 2026-10-20 while checking the sidebar float, already live without it): https://kidsoverprofits.org/facility/cedar-crest-hospital-rtc-tx/ at 1360 wide has a 1457px scroll width; no element in `body` reports a box past the viewport, so look for a transform, an off-screen tooltip or `100vw` width. The operator page is fine.

**Desktop sidebar float** (js/sidebar-float.js, 2026-10-20): at 1025px and up the newsletter + donate sidebar floats in the content panel's top corner and the page runs full width below it. A panel that would leave under 440px of text beside it (the state report pages' fixed-width box) keeps Kadence's column. Checked at 1100 and 1360 with the working tree injected on the live home, open data, facility, operator and CA report pages; at 800 it goes back after the content. If a page looks wrong there, raise `MIN_TEXT` or check which box `findPanel()` picks for it. Moving the sidebar makes the Givebutter widget rebuild its Donate button without the contrast rule (white on #FF8A00, 2.36:1); js/givebutter-contrast.js now watches each widget and patches the new button (2026-10-21, checked by moving the sidebar after the patch). check-contrast.py passes with the float on /, /open-data/, a facility page, /ca-reports/.

items.lead: MailerLite Subscribe button spills 6px at 1100 wide
items.text: **MailerLite Subscribe button spills 6px at 1100 wide** (found 2026-10-21, not from the float: /open-data/ did it before the float, and /ca-reports/, which keeps Kadence's column, does it now): `python -u scripts/check-mobile-overflow.py --widths 1100 /ca-reports/` reports `div.ml-button-horizontal.primary > button.primary` "Subscribe" 6px out. The newsletter form's horizontal row is too narrow for the button in a 338px column; let the row wrap or shrink the button padding in css/sidebar.css.
**Accessibility pass**: VoiceOver and TalkBack, the largest font and a tablet (colours in `src/theme/colors.ts` follow `css/colors.css`).
**Deep links** on a device (`npx uri-scheme open kidsoverprofits://facility/<slug>`); site addresses after 2.6 item 4.
**Essential reporting**: the strip above the news tab, the flag and note on a card, a list for `?featured=1`.
**News tab filters**: the story and month filters reset when it unmounts.
**Payload notes**: the app payload's `notes` list still carries the Woodbury wording and raw addresses (both readers clean them when they print).
**Map tab coupling** (a standing caution): the map page's class names and button ids are read by the app (`mapPage.ts`, `mapBridge.ts`): renaming one on the website breaks the Map tab.
